market_education.summary_en: Tech stocks led modestly today, with the NASDAQ up 0.7% while the broader S&P 500 finished flat. That gap usually means investors are rotating toward growth and technology names rather than buying across the whole market. Many cybersecurity and software stocks such as CRWD, ZS and PANW are showing bullish momentum signals, which fits the NASDAQ's outperformance. No specific news headlines were provided today, so no outside sources are cited.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股溫和領漲，納斯達克指數上升0.7%，標普500指數則收平。兩者表現分歧，通常反映資金正流向成長股及科技股，而非全面買入大市。CrowdStrike、Zscaler及Palo Alto等網絡安全及軟件股普遍出現看漲動能訊號，與納指跑贏大市的走勢一致。由於今日未有提供具體新聞標題，故未引用外部消息來源。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sector rotation is when investors move money from one part of the market into another, for example from defensive stocks into technology. Today the tech-heavy NASDAQ rose while the S&P 500 stayed flat, which suggests money was shifting toward tech rather than the whole market rising together. Watching these shifts helps you see which areas have momentum.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 板塊輪動是指投資者把資金從市場某一板塊轉移到另一板塊，例如由防守型股票轉投科技股。今日以科技股為主的納斯達克指數上升，標普500指數卻持平，顯示資金正流向科技板塊，而非整體市場同步上揚。留意這類資金流向，有助投資者找出哪些板塊具備上升動能。
